question: What offering makes a sādhaka wealthy in food within three months?
premises: dadhyanna homa is the prescribed offering
the result occurs within three months
inference: Offering curd-rice makes the practitioner wealthy in food within three months.
uncertainties: whether trimāsataḥ means within or after three months
plain_english: By offering curd-rice, the practitioner becomes wealthy in food within three months.
